---
title: "06 - Do Combine times relate to NFL route movement?"
author: "Hunter Clark"
output: 
  html_document: 
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

This notebook examines whether faster official forty times relate to higher NFL speed two seconds after snap, and whether faster 10-yard splits relate to greater first-second speed gain. It also tests whether the Combine 3–7 speed-building interval adds predictive information beyond official testing results.

The analysis uses Combine WR prospects running rookie regular-season GO routes from WR or slot alignments, without pre-snap motion and on plays not nullified by penalty. Outcomes measure observed speed in raw supplied units, rather than route quality or overall NFL performance.

## Read matching tracking observations

```{r read-matching-tracking}
read_matching_routes <- function(file, keys) {
  chunks <- list()
  scanned <- 0

  header <- names(
    read_csv(
      file,
      n_max = 0,
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  )

  required <- c(
    route_keys,
    "time",
    "s",
    "event"
  )

  if (!all(required %in% header)) {
    stop("Required tracking columns are missing.")
  }

  callback <- SideEffectChunkCallback$new(
    function(chunk, position) {
      if (nrow(problems(chunk))) {
        stop("Tracking CSV parsing failed.")
      }

      scanned <<- scanned + nrow(chunk)

      keep <- semi_join(
        chunk,
        keys,
        by = route_keys
      )

      if (nrow(keep)) {
        chunks[[length(chunks) + 1L]] <<- keep
      }
    }
  )

  read_csv_chunked(
    file,
    callback,
    chunk_size = 100000L,
    col_types = cols_only(
      game_id = col_character(),
      play_id = col_character(),
      nfl_id = col_character(),
      time = col_character(),
      s = col_character(),
      event = col_character()
    ),
    na = c("", "NA", "<NA>"),
    progress = FALSE,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  list(
    frames = bind_rows(chunks),
    scanned = scanned
  )
}

reads <- lapply(
  seq_along(seasons),
  function(i) {
    message("Reading ", seasons[i])

    keys <- candidate_routes |>
      filter(draft_year == seasons[i]) |>
      select(all_of(route_keys))

    read_matching_routes(
      tracking_files[i],
      keys
    )
  }
)

tracking_read_summary <- tibble(
  season = seasons,

  rows_scanned = vapply(
    reads,
    function(x) x$scanned,
    numeric(1)
  ),

  matched_frames = vapply(
    reads,
    function(x) nrow(x$frames),
    integer(1)
  )
)

tracking <- bind_rows(
  lapply(reads, `[[`, "frames")
) |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = as.POSIXct(
      time,
      format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OS",
      tz = "UTC"
    ),

    speed_raw = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(s)
    )
  )

rm(reads)

print(tracking_read_summary)
```

## Measure both time horizons

```{r measure-horizons}
measure_horizon <- function(data, horizon) {
  data <- arrange(data, timestamp)

  result <- function(
      status,
      snap = NA_real_,
      speed = NA_real_,
      pass = NA_real_) {

    tibble(
      horizon_s = horizon,
      outcome_status = status,
      snap_speed_raw = snap,
      horizon_speed_raw = speed,
      speed_gain_raw = speed - snap,
      snap_to_pass_s = pass
    )
  }

  if (
    anyNA(data$timestamp) ||
    any(!is.finite(data$speed_raw)) ||
    any(data$speed_raw < 0)
  ) {
    return(
      result("Invalid tracking values")
    )
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(data$timestamp)) {
    return(
      result("Duplicate timestamps")
    )
  }

  snap <- which(
    data$event == "ball_snap"
  )

  pass <- which(
    data$event == "pass_forward"
  )

  if (length(snap) != 1L) {
    return(
      result("Missing or multiple snap events")
    )
  }

  if (length(pass) != 1L) {
    return(
      result("Missing or multiple pass events")
    )
  }

  t <- round(
    as.numeric(
      difftime(
        data$timestamp,
        data$timestamp[snap],
        units = "secs"
      )
    ),
    digits = 6
  )

  pass_t <- t[pass]

  if (pass_t < horizon - 1e-6) {
    return(
      result(
        "Pass before horizon",
        pass = pass_t
      )
    )
  }

  endpoint <- which(
    abs(t - horizon) <= 1e-6
  )

  if (length(endpoint) != 1L) {
    return(
      result(
        "Missing horizon frame",
        pass = pass_t
      )
    )
  }

  window <- which(
    t >= -1e-6 &
      t <= horizon + 1e-6
  )

  expected <- seq(
    0,
    horizon,
    by = 0.1
  )

  if (
    length(window) != length(expected) ||
    any(abs(t[window] - expected) > 1e-6)
  ) {
    return(
      result(
        "Incomplete horizon tracking",
        pass = pass_t
      )
    )
  }

  result(
    "Measured",
    data$speed_raw[snap],
    data$speed_raw[endpoint],
    pass_t
  )
}

movement <- tracking |>
  group_by(across(all_of(route_keys))) |>
  group_modify(
    ~ bind_rows(
      measure_horizon(.x, 1),
      measure_horizon(.x, 2)
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

route_movement <- candidate_routes |>
  left_join(
    movement,
    by = route_keys,
    relationship = "one-to-many"
  )

if (
  anyNA(route_movement$outcome_status) ||
  nrow(route_movement) != 2L * nrow(candidate_routes)
) {
  stop("Missing route/horizon audit.")
}

outcome_coverage <- route_movement |>
  count(
    draft_year,
    horizon_s,
    outcome_status,
    name = "routes"
  )

print(outcome_coverage, n = Inf)
```

## Relationships with official testing results

The planned primary pairings are:

- Official 10-yard split versus first-second speed gain.
- Official forty time versus speed at two seconds.

```{r association-analysis}
safe_cor <- function(
    x,
    y,
    method = "pearson") {

  if (
    length(x) < 3L ||
    sd(x) == 0 ||
    sd(y) == 0
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  cor(
    x,
    y,
    method = method
  )
}

planned <- analysis_data |>
  mutate(
    official_time_s = if_else(
      horizon_s == 1,
      official_ten_split_s,
      official_forty_s
    ),

    pairing = if_else(
      horizon_s == 1,
      "10-yard split vs first-second gain",
      "Forty time vs two-second speed"
    )
  )

associations_by_year <- planned |>
  group_by(pairing, draft_year) |>
  summarise(
    players = n(),

    pearson = safe_cor(
      official_time_s,
      outcome
    ),

    spearman = safe_cor(
      official_time_s,
      outcome,
      "spearman"
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

pooled_associations <- planned |>
  group_by(pairing) |>
  summarise(
    players = n(),

    pearson = safe_cor(
      official_time_s,
      outcome
    ),

    spearman = safe_cor(
      official_time_s,
      outcome,
      "spearman"
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(pooled_associations)

print(
  associations_by_year,
  n = Inf
)
```

## Year-adjusted relationships and uncertainty

```{r adjusted-associations}
stratified_indices <- function(data) {
  groups <- split(
    seq_len(nrow(data)),
    data$draft_year
  )

  unlist(
    lapply(
      groups,
      function(i) {
        i[
          sample.int(
            length(i),
            length(i),
            replace = TRUE
          )
        ]
      }
    ),
    use.names = FALSE
  )
}

set.seed(2030)

adjusted_associations <- planned |>
  group_by(pairing) |>
  group_modify(
    ~ {
      data <- .x

      get_stats <- function(d) {
        fit <- lm(
          outcome ~
            official_time_s +
            factor(draft_year),
          data = d
        )

        time_residuals <- resid(
          lm(
            official_time_s ~ factor(draft_year),
            data = d
          )
        )

        outcome_residuals <- resid(
          lm(
            outcome ~ factor(draft_year),
            data = d
          )
        )

        c(
          correlation = safe_cor(
            time_residuals,
            outcome_residuals
          ),

          change_per_0_10s_faster = unname(
            -0.1 *
              coef(fit)["official_time_s"]
          )
        )
      }

      point <- get_stats(data)

      draws <- replicate(
        2000L,
        get_stats(
          data[stratified_indices(data), ]
        )
      )

      tibble(
        players = nrow(data),

        year_adjusted_pearson = point[1],

        correlation_p025 = quantile(
          draws[1, ],
          0.025,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        correlation_p975 = quantile(
          draws[1, ],
          0.975,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        change_per_0_10s_faster = point[2],

        change_p025 = quantile(
          draws[2, ],
          0.025,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        change_p975 = quantile(
          draws[2, ],
          0.975,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      )
    }
  ) |>
  ungroup()

print(
  adjusted_associations,
  width = Inf
)
```

## Do route summaries repeat across games?

```{r game-split-consistency}
measured <- route_movement |>
  filter(outcome_status == "Measured") |>
  mutate(
    endpoint = if_else(
      horizon_s == 1,
      "First-second speed gain",
      "Speed at two seconds"
    ),

    outcome = if_else(
      horizon_s == 1,
      speed_gain_raw,
      horizon_speed_raw
    )
  ) |>
  semi_join(
    analysis_data |>
      select(nfl_id, horizon_s),
    by = c("nfl_id", "horizon_s")
  )

set.seed(2031)

split_results <- lapply(
  seq_len(100L),
  function(rep_id) {
    halves <- measured |>
      distinct(
        nfl_id,
        horizon_s,
        game_id
      ) |>
      arrange(
        nfl_id,
        horizon_s,
        game_id
      ) |>
      group_by(nfl_id, horizon_s) |>
      mutate(
        half = sample(
          rep(
            1:2,
            length.out = n()
          )
        )
      ) |>
      ungroup()

    means <- measured |>
      left_join(
        halves,
        by = c(
          "nfl_id",
          "horizon_s",
          "game_id"
        ),
        relationship = "many-to-one"
      ) |>
      group_by(
        endpoint,
        draft_year,
        nfl_id,
        half
      ) |>
      summarise(
        routes = n(),
        value = mean(outcome),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = half,
        values_from = c(
          routes,
          value
        ),
        names_sep = "_"
      ) |>
      filter(
        !is.na(routes_1),
        !is.na(routes_2),
        routes_1 >= 5,
        routes_2 >= 5
      )

    means |>
      group_by(endpoint) |>
      summarise(
        split_id = rep_id,

        players = n(),

        pearson = safe_cor(
          value_1,
          value_2
        ),

        spearman = safe_cor(
          value_1,
          value_2,
          "spearman"
        ),

        median_absolute_difference = median(
          abs(value_1 - value_2)
        ),

        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }
) |>
  bind_rows()

split_consistency <- split_results |>
  group_by(endpoint) |>
  summarise(
    minimum_players = min(players),

    maximum_players = max(players),

    median_split_pearson = median(
      pearson,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    median_split_spearman = median(
      spearman,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    median_absolute_half_difference = median(
      median_absolute_difference
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(
  split_consistency,
  width = Inf
)
```

## Held-out prediction

```{r prediction-function}
evaluate_relationship_models <- function(
    data,
    context = FALSE,
    with_interval = FALSE,
    threshold = 10L,
    seed = 2027L) {

  d <- data |>
    filter(measured_routes >= threshold) |>
    mutate(
      draft_year = factor(draft_year)
    ) |>
    arrange(draft_year, nfl_id)

  if (with_interval) {
    d <- d |>
      filter(
        is.finite(mean_combine_interval_s)
      )
  }

  if (
    anyDuplicated(d$nfl_id) ||
    any(table(d$draft_year) < 5L)
  ) {
    stop(
      "Insufficient players per year or duplicate modeling rows."
    )
  }

  base <- if (context) {
    paste(
      "draft_year",
      "+ mean_snap_speed_raw",
      "+ slot_route_share"
    )
  } else {
    "draft_year"
  }

  rhs <- c(
    "Year reference" = base,

    "Forty only" = paste(
      base,
      "+ official_forty_s"
    ),

    "10-yard split only" = paste(
      base,
      "+ official_ten_split_s"
    ),

    "Both official tests" = paste(
      base,
      "+ official_forty_s",
      "+ official_ten_split_s"
    )
  )

  if (context) {
    names(rhs)[1] <- "Year + context reference"
  }

  if (with_interval) {
    rhs <- c(
      rhs,

      "Both tests + interval" = paste(
        base,
        "+ official_forty_s",
        "+ official_ten_split_s",
        "+ mean_combine_interval_s"
      )
    )
  }

  formulas <- lapply(
    rhs,
    function(r) {
      as.formula(
        paste("outcome ~", r)
      )
    }
  )

  model_columns <- unique(
    unlist(
      lapply(formulas, all.vars)
    )
  )

  if (anyNA(d[, model_columns])) {
    stop("Incomplete model inputs.")
  }

  set.seed(seed)

  results <- list()

  for (repeat_id in seq_len(20L)) {
    assigned <- d |>
      group_by(draft_year) |>
      mutate(
        fold_id = sample(
          rep(
            1:5,
            length.out = n()
          )
        )
      ) |>
      ungroup()

    for (fold in 1:5) {
      train <- assigned |>
        filter(fold_id != fold)

      test <- assigned |>
        filter(fold_id == fold)

      stopifnot(
        !any(train$nfl_id %in% test$nfl_id)
      )

      for (name in names(formulas)) {
        fit <- lm(
          formulas[[name]],
          data = train
        )

        if (
          fit$rank <
          ncol(model.matrix(fit))
        ) {
          stop(
            "Rank-deficient training model."
          )
        }

        prediction <- as.numeric(
          predict(
            fit,
            newdata = test
          )
        )

        stopifnot(
          all(is.finite(prediction))
        )

        results[[length(results) + 1L]] <- tibble(
          nfl_id = test$nfl_id,
          draft_year = as.character(test$draft_year),
          repeat_id = repeat_id,
          fold_id = fold,
          model = name,
          observed = test$outcome,
          predicted = prediction
        )
      }
    }
  }

  predictions <- bind_rows(results)

  stopifnot(
    nrow(predictions) ==
      nrow(d) * 20L * length(formulas),

    all(
      count(
        predictions,
        nfl_id,
        repeat_id,
        model
      )$n == 1L
    )
  )

  metrics <- predictions |>
    group_by(model) |>
    summarise(
      players = n_distinct(nfl_id),

      rmse = sqrt(
        mean(
          (observed - predicted)^2
        )
      ),

      mae = mean(
        abs(observed - predicted)
      ),

      .groups = "drop"
    )

  list(
    metrics = metrics,
    predictions = predictions
  )
}
```

## Evaluate primary and sensitivity models

```{r evaluate-models}
model_runs <- list()

for (
  endpoint_name in unique(analysis_data$endpoint)
) {
  d <- filter(
    analysis_data,
    endpoint == endpoint_name
  )

  for (
    setting in c(
      "Official times: 10 routes",
      "Official times: 20 routes",
      "Context sensitivity",
      "Interval increment"
    )
  ) {
    run <- evaluate_relationship_models(
      d,

      context =
        setting == "Context sensitivity",

      with_interval =
        setting == "Interval increment",

      threshold = if (
        setting == "Official times: 20 routes"
      ) {
        20L
      } else {
        10L
      }
    )

    run$endpoint <- endpoint_name
    run$analysis <- setting

    model_runs[[
      paste(
        endpoint_name,
        setting,
        sep = " | "
      )
    ]] <- run
  }
}

model_metrics <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    model_runs,
    function(x) {
      mutate(
        x$metrics,
        endpoint = x$endpoint,
        analysis = x$analysis
      )
    }
  )
)

print(
  model_metrics,
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)
```

## Conditional uncertainty in prediction gains

```{r prediction-gain-intervals}
set.seed(2032)

prediction_gains <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    model_runs,
    function(run) {
      errors <- run$predictions |>
        group_by(
          nfl_id,
          draft_year,
          model
        ) |>
        summarise(
          mse = mean(
            (observed - predicted)^2
          ),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) |>
        pivot_wider(
          names_from = model,
          values_from = mse
        )

      reference_name <- if (
        "Year + context reference" %in%
          names(errors)
      ) {
        "Year + context reference"
      } else {
        "Year reference"
      }

      comparisons <- list(
        c(
          reference_name,
          "Forty only"
        ),

        c(
          reference_name,
          "10-yard split only"
        ),

        c(
          reference_name,
          "Both official tests"
        )
      )

      if (
        "Both tests + interval" %in%
          names(errors)
      ) {
        comparisons <- c(
          comparisons,

          list(
            c(
              "Both official tests",
              "Both tests + interval"
            )
          )
        )
      }

      bind_rows(
        lapply(
          comparisons,
          function(pair) {
            a <- errors[[pair[1]]]
            b <- errors[[pair[2]]]

            draws <- replicate(
              2000L,
              {
                i <- stratified_indices(errors)

                sqrt(mean(a[i])) -
                  sqrt(mean(b[i]))
              }
            )

            tibble(
              endpoint = run$endpoint,
              analysis = run$analysis,
              reference = pair[1],
              added_model = pair[2],
              players = nrow(errors),

              rmse_gain =
                sqrt(mean(a)) -
                sqrt(mean(b)),

              conditional_p025 = quantile(
                draws,
                0.025
              ),

              conditional_p975 = quantile(
                draws,
                0.975
              )
            )
          }
        )
      )
    }
  )
)

print(
  prediction_gains,
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)
```

## Official testing versus route movement

```{r relationship-figure, fig.height=6}
year_colors <- c(
  "2023" = "#007C91",
  "2024" = "#D66A25",
  "2025" = "#7652A3"
)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
)

relationship_plot <- ggplot(
  planned,
  aes(
    official_time_s,
    outcome,
    colour = draft_year
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ pairing,
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = year_colors
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(
      "Does faster Combine testing accompany",
      "faster NFL route movement?"
    ),

    subtitle = paste(
      "One point per receiver;",
      "lines fitted separately within draft year"
    ),

    x = "Official test time (s): lower is faster",

    y = "Mean NFL movement (raw speed units)",

    colour = "Draft year",

    caption = paste(
      paste(
        "Nonmotion rookie GO routes;",
        "at least 10 measured routes for each outcome."
      ),

      paste(
        "Two-second speed requires a pass at or after two seconds.",
        "Association is not causation."
      ),

      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

relationship_plot

ggsave(
  file.path(
    out,
    "figures",
    "01_official_times_vs_route_movement.png"

  width = 12,
  height = 6.5,
  dpi = 200
)
```

```{r save-results}
tables <- list(

  player_coverage = player_coverage,
  horizon_selection = horizon_selection,
  analysis_roster = analysis_roster,
  pooled_associations = pooled_associations,
  associations_by_year = associations_by_year,
```
